## Summary

This is a Spring PetClinic REST app converted to OfficeFloor function injection. The single endpoint under active development is `POST /api/owners`. DTOs (`OwnerDto`, `OwnerFieldsDto`) are **generated** from `openapi.yml` by the openapi-generator-maven-plugin, not hand-written. There is **no** `bulkSignupWarning` field anywhere in production code yet — it appears only in a test that currently asserts the default (`false`).

---

## 1. YAML for creating an owner (POST)

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`**

This defines the full create pipeline (each step's `next` chains to the following one). Order:
`validate (RequireOwnerFields)` → `unique (RequireUniqueTelephone)` → `household (RequireUniqueHousehold)` → `capacity (RequireCityCapacity)` → `dailyLimit (RequireDailyLimit)` → `build (BuildOwner)` → `assignCode (AssignCustomerCode)` → `assignHousehold (AssignHousehold)` → `assignNamesakeCount (AssignNamesakeCount)` → `save (SaveOwner)` → `audit (AuditOwnerCreated)` → `respond (RespondWithOwnerCreated)`. All steps are governed by `transaction`; endpoint requires role `OWNER_ADMIN`. (Full contents shown earlier — 62 lines.)

Related: `owners.GET.yml` (ListOwners) and `owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml` (LoadOwner → RespondWithOwner) — the read-back path tests use to assert fields.

---

## 2. Create-owner pipeline Java classes

All under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`:

- **`RequireOwnerFields.java`** — manual required-field guard; normalizes address (via `AddressNormalizer`), telephone to E.164 (via `Telephones`), lowercases email. Emits `Out<OwnerFieldsDto> validated`.
- **`RequireUniqueTelephone.java`** — rejects duplicate telephone (409). Uses `ownerRepository.findAll()`.
- **`RequireUniqueHousehold.java`** — rejects same last name + address unless `sharesHousehold` true (409).
- **`RequireCityCapacity.java`** — rejects when city already has `CAPACITY = 50` owners (409). Counts via `ownerRepository.findAll().stream().filter(city match).count()`.
- **`RequireDailyLimit.java`** — rejects when `DAILY_LIMIT = 100` owners already share the effective registration date (429). **This is the closest analog to a "created today" count** — it filters `ownerRepository.findAll()` by `effective.equals(existing.getRegistrationDate())`, where `effective = BusinessDays.toBusinessDay(supplied ?? LocalDate.now())`.
- **`BuildOwner.java`** — maps DTO to `Owner`; defaults `registrationDate` to `LocalDate.now()` if absent, then rolls to business day.
- **`AssignCustomerCode.java`** — sets `customerCode` `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (per-city sequence via count).
- **`AssignHousehold.java`** — sets/back-fills `householdId` (SHA-256 prefix) when `sharesHousehold`.
- **`AssignNamesakeCount.java`** — sets `namesakeCount` = count of existing owners with same first+last name.
- **`SaveOwner.java`** — `ownerRepository.save(owner)`.
- **`AuditOwnerCreated.java`** — logs to the `AUDIT` logger: `"Owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={}"`.
- **`RespondWithOwnerCreated.java`** — maps to `OwnerDto`, sends `201 Created` with `Location: /api/owners/{id}`.

Helpers (same dir): **`Telephones.java`** (E.164 normalization), **`AddressNormalizer.java`** (address canonicalization). (Full contents of all shown earlier.)

Shared utility: **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/BusinessDays.java`** — `toBusinessDay()` rolls Sat→Mon, Sun→Mon (note: production version does NOT skip holidays, unlike the test's version).

---

## 3. Owner entity & repository

**Entity: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`** (extends `Person`). Fields: `address`, `city`, `telephone`, `email`, **`registrationDate` (`LocalDate`, column `registration_date`)**, `customerCode`, `householdId`, `namesakeCount`, `pets`. 

Important: **there is NO `createdAt`/`createdDate`/timestamp field** — the only date is `registrationDate` (a `LocalDate`, not a timestamp). "Created today" is expressed via `registrationDate`.

**Repository: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/OwnerRepository.java`** — interface methods: `findByLastName(String)`, `findByLastName(String, Pageable)`, `findById(int)`, `save(Owner)`, **`findAll()`** (returns `Collection<Owner>`), `findAll(Pageable)`, `delete(Owner)`. There is **no count-by-date or count method** — all pipeline counting is done in-memory by streaming `findAll()` and filtering.

Implementations exist under `repository/jpa/JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl.java`, `repository/springdatajpa/SpringDataOwnerRepository.java` (Spring Data has JPQL `SELECT COUNT(owner)...` queries but those aren't on the `OwnerRepository` interface used by the functions).

DB schema (`registration_date DATE`, `namesake_count INTEGER`, no created timestamp) in:
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/db/h2/schema.sql` (owners table lines 31-43), plus mysql/postgres/hsqldb variants.

---

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When omitted on create, it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner shares the same last name and address (e.g. a spouse or family member at the same address).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A customer code assigned on create, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three
                letters of lastName, and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one
                more than the number of owners already in that city at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A membership number derived on create, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits of the
                registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners who live together at the same
                address, assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true.
                Every member of the household receives the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-

## Summary

Added a `bulkSignupWarning` flag to the owner-create flow: it is `true` when **more than 80 owners had already been created** for the same (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the moment this owner was created, and `false` otherwise. It's computed once at create time and persisted, so it reads back consistently on `GET /api/owners/{id}` (the path the acceptance test asserts against) — the same snapshot pattern the existing `namesakeCount` field uses.

### Changes
- **New pipeline step** `AssignBulkSignupWarning.java` — counts existing owners sharing the new owner's effective `registrationDate` (before the save, so the new owner isn't counted) and sets `bulkSignupWarning = count > 80`. This mirrors `RequireDailyLimit`'s accumulation path (the daily hard cap is 100, so the warning band is 81–100), exactly as the test's javadoc describes.
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the step in between `assignNamesakeCount` and `save`, under the same `transaction` governance, so it runs after `BuildOwner` sets the effective date and before persistence.
- **`Owner.java`** — added the `bulkSignupWarning` (`Boolean`, column `bulk_signup_warning`) field with getter/setter.
- **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `bulkSignupWarning` boolean to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it.
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added a mapping expression coalescing a `null` stored value to `false`, guaranteeing the response is always a boolean (never null) per the "otherwise false" spec.
- **`schema.sql`** for all four DBs (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added the `bulk_signup_warning` column.

- The existing `AcceptanceTest.coreNoBulkWarningUnderThreshold` (fresh create → `false`) passes; full suite is `BUILD SUCCESS`.
- I also ran a throwaway boundary test confirming both branches (81 already created → `true`; exactly 80 → `false`), then removed it and re-ran the full suite green.
